Why it matters now

AI answers are built from what others say about you.

When buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google's AI Overviews for a shortlist, the answer leans on publications, roundups and reviews, not your homepage. Earned media gets you into those sources. It's the PR half of our AEO work.

How we work

From story to placement.

01

Find the story

We dig for what is genuinely newsworthy: original data, a sharp founder point of view, a launch or a customer story with specifics.

02

Pick the targets

A shortlist of the editors, reporters and roundup authors your category reads, plus the sites AI engines already cite for your buyers’ questions.

03

Pitch and place

Contributed bylines, features, expert quotes and roundup inclusions. Sponsored placements are always disclosed.

04

Reuse every win

Each placement goes onto your site, sales decks and LinkedIn, and into your AI-visibility tracking, so it keeps working after launch day.
